# Vendored front-end libraries

| File | Project | Version | License |
|---|---|---|---|
| htmx.min.js | https://htmx.org | 2.0.4 | Zero-Clause BSD |
| uplot.min.js, uplot.min.css | https://github.com/leeoniya/uPlot | 1.6.31 | MIT |
